intent: Specify the public broadword API of `succinct::broadword`: `count_ones`, `u_nz8` and `u_le8` (with the public constants `L8` and `H8`).

manual_mutants.note: drops the `| x` term: a byte equal to 0x80 is reported as zero
drops the `^ (x & !y)` correction: wrong when x's byte has the high bit and y's does not
signed-style combination (as in le8): wrong when the bytes differ in their high bit
checked multiplication by L8 overflows (panics) whenever a high byte is non-zero
first-step mask misses bit 63: wrong count only for words with the top bit set

bug_variants.source: injected regression (promoted manual mutant #3); no usable historical fix found upstream
bug_variants.note: count_ones multiplies by L8 with a checked multiplication: panics whenever the summed byte counts overflow 64 bits (any word with a set bit in a high byte), although the module documents that the algorithm relies on wrapping arithmetic in its last line
